title: no verb corrects a node's name or role, so a mistaken registration is undone only by editing a generated file or the store
body:
No verb corrects a node's name or role. `wb register` refuses a re-register with different values (`WbRegisteredDifferently`, `facade.rs:5732`), `intent wb --help` lists no unregister verb, and `register --help` offers no update or force. What remains is hand-editing `intent/whiteboard/<node>/board.json`, a generated file, and running `intent sync --to-store` (the carrier declared at `store.rs:644`, `:659`, `:678` and read back at `ingest.rs:296`), or editing `wb_node` directly. devbin/vc's fix for the foreign `vc` row on 2026-09-16 needed a `DELETE` on `wb_node`. A mistake made through the verbs can be undone only outside them. Devbin letter I, measured by both.

Found by devbin migrating its boards on Intent 3.0.3 (`d24487079`), sent through intent/vc on hv's routing, and ruled by hv on 2026-09-16 to be fixed in this release (hv decision 18). The full measurement record, with the instrument (`carry-map.sh`, driven red and green) and who measured what, is devbin `1824c75`, `intent/whiteboard/dc/.history/20260916/wb-upstream-defects-draft.md`.

Fix: a verb (or a flag on `register`) that changes a registered node's name or role, refusing nothing it should not, and leaving its board, items and messages attached.

**CLOSED 2026-09-16, landed on vc's word with bank 2 (0410, 0417, 0413) under vc decision 21 (1).** `intent wb register <moniker> --name --role --correct` changes a registered node's name and role and nothing else, and its board, items and messages stay attached. It refuses an unregistered moniker (`WbCorrectUnregistered`, whose remedy names plain `register`), so it never creates a node. It answers `unchanged` at rc 0 and records nothing when the values are already held. Otherwise it writes one `wb.correct` event through the whiteboard's one store door. `WbRegisteredDifferently`'s remedy names it with the held and offered values. The dispatch register carries the flag, and the reference set lists it at its next whole regeneration (vc). Guarded by `native/rust/crates/intent-cli/tests/wb_register_correct.rs`.
